function.name: calculate_french_data_tax
function.description: Calculates tax liability under France's proposed €0.055/GB bandwidth tax with statutory revenue caps (15% French / 2% Global).

volume.description: Total data volume delivered to French users.

turnover_fr.description: Annual French company turnover in EUR (for 15% statutory cap calculation).

turnover_global.description: Annual global turnover in EUR (for 2% statutory cap calculation).

subscribers_fr.description: Total active French subscriber base to calculate pass-through cost per user.

function.name: simulate_streaming_workload
function.description: Calculates aggregate bandwidth consumption and tax for live or on-demand video streaming workloads delivered to French users.

average_bitrate_mbps.description: Average stream bitrate in Megabits per second (Mbps).

hours_per_day.description: Average viewing hours per user per day.

function.name: assess_distribution_economics
function.description: Determines whether a digital payload (e.g., game download, AI checkpoint, video stream) can be profitably delivered to France under the €0.055/GB tax.

sale_price_eur.description: Revenue generated per download/transaction in EUR.

cdn_cost_per_gb.description: CDN transit cost per gigabyte in EUR.
